text:
hazel: ok here's the crime scene, found my socks like this this morning 😂 (image: IMG_1234.jpg)
ben: SO CUTE. is that... a sock tower? :mind_blown: 
tara: immediate sock inventory required. how many are missing? :eyes: 
hazel: estimated 7. also she folded them? idk. cat forensics incoming. 
alek: Legend says cats stack socks to build a pillow fortress. science. 
ben: please send more pics. also concerned about ingestion — is she chewing them? 
hazel: no chewing, just kneading and rearranging. tiny claw prints on top :paw_prints: 
luna-bot: [photo collage generated] "hazel_cat_socks_collage.png" 
ben: poll: leave the socks where they are vs reclaim them now 
tara: leave them. it's her art installation. :art: 
hazel: fine, new rule: soft art exhibits only in living room. :museum: 
alek: warning: stepping on the sock tower at 3am -> catastrophic foot injury. vote reclaim. 
ben: ok reclaim at 10pm. rescue mission volunteers? @alek @tara 
tara: i volunteer, wearing steel-toe slippers :raised_hands: 
hazel: thank you heroes. i'll bring treats as bribe :cookie: 
ben: mandatory photo evidence required. 
hazel: will deliver before/after. dramatic soundtrack optional. :movie_camera:
